subject: Emotions
title: Honor Killings
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Honor Killings.

hook.text: Thousands of people are killed yearly by family members to 'restore honor.' The crime is shaming the family name.

buildup.text: Honor killings occur when an individual's behavior—usually a woman's—is perceived to shame the entire family.

discovery.text: The UN estimates 5,000 honor killings annually. Most victims are women punished for love, clothing, or autonomy.

twist.text: Honor killing predates Islam, Christianity, and Judaism. It's rooted in clan-based shame systems, not religion.

climax.text: Legal reform alone fails. The shame system must change—redefining honor as protecting family, not controlling them.

punchline.text: When shame kills, the system is the real criminal.

quiz.question: How many honor killings does the UN estimate annually?
